cv_sections.summary:
DevOps-native engineer with a passion for building resilient, cloud-
native infrastructures using Kubernetes, Docker, and GitOps
principles. I specialize in backend development with Go and Python
(FastAPI), designing scalable APIs with precision and performance
in mind. As the architect of SpoutBreeze, an open-source webinar
platform powered by BigBlueButton, I’ve led the development of
microservices-based systems from the ground up. I thrive in fast-
paced, startup-like environments where open-source collaboration,
automation, and clean architecture come together. A builder by
heart and debugger by instinct, I’m driven by the challenge of turning
complexity into elegant, reliable systems.
